During this take off I will handle the flight controls and power controls. I'd like you to monitor the engine instruments. If you see anything abnormal, point it out and I will take the necessary action.

If during this take off anything abnormal occurs: - I will abort if we are still on the runway - If we are airborne with sufficient runway remaining, I will abort if the gear is still down. - If we are airborne and committed to fly, I will perform the immediate action procedures, maintain blue line at 83 KIAS and return for a landing - If we experience an engine failure during cruise I will perform immediate action procedures and trouble shoot using the checklist
If I need assistance I will ask for it specifically
